claim_summary: ReasonCast contributes a routed semantic intervention for demand forecasting: an LLM reasoner emits structured event fields, a three-action routing policy decides whether to intervene, and the fields are fused into a frozen Chronos-2 forecaster with gated additive and multiplicative corrections.

claim_evidence.quote: We formulate event-enhanced demand forecasting as selective semantic intervention, shifting the focus from extracting more text to controlling its marginal influence on a strong numerical forecaster.

modules.name: Structured event-semantics reasoner (schema SFT and semantic-field RL)
modules.scope_reason: R2 LLM: schema SFT and semantic-field RL change the parameters of the Qwen3-32B reasoner that emits structured event fields; R3 layer tests not applied to LLM modules.

evidence.quote: Reasoner supervision. We stratify 40,000 item–window candidates by trajectory regime and obtain 11,627 teacher generations.
parseable and internally consistent outputs, and semantic-field RL improves forecast-critical judgments such as direction, amplitude, and peak intensity.

modules.name: Forecast-utility trained routing policy (Skip, Basic, Tool)
modules.scope_reason: R2 LLM: a trained policy selects the route from forecast-utility rewards computed by a frozen forecaster; the workflow around it is not a separate harness module in the packet.

evidence.quote: Given event context, the no-text forecast, and its entropy, the agent selects Skip, low-cost Basic semantics, or tool-augmented Tool
Forecast-utility RL trains the agent policy—including route selection, tool use, and the final intervention decision—against realized downstream utility from the frozen forecaster

modules.name: Event-selective dual-path fusion into the Chronos-2 forecaster
modules.scope_reason: R2 LLM: trainable text encoder, aligner and fusion layers change how text tokens enter the forecaster representation; the frozen TSFM is not modified. Alternative reading as TSK is noted.

evidence.quote: The interface is applied to the Chronos-2 future-token representation before the prediction head. Thus, only the event component queries text
changes but may have limited authority over large level shifts. We therefore introduce a complementary multiplicative correction:
The property is enforced by the routing action and an explicit mask rather than learned approximately.

process_validity.quote: SFT establishes parseability and improves direction and shape;

temporal_validity.quote: To prevent temporal leakage, all textual descriptions and event information are restricted to records available before the corresponding forecast origin.

task_performance.quote: ReasonCast obtains the lowest WMAPE on all six proprietary event slices and on M5 event windows

notes: Blind pass. The packet describes a single-pass route, then semantic generation, then fusion; tool observations do not change the next action, so fixed_workflow per R0. Tool augmentation (event evidence, temporal statistics) is a route option and is not counted as a separate Harness module. Chronos-2 is the frozen TSFM backbone and is not a contribution. Fusion layer ambiguity (LLM representation_alignment vs TSK) flagged. process_validity is marked on parseability of structured outputs, a medium-confidence reading.
